profile.headline: Senior Software Developer In Test at CHG Healthcare
profile.summary:
Seeking a position where my skills can benefit the quality of the product and its customers using the same goal-driven and creative methods I used to become a champion musician and 4th-degree black belt in karate.  I attack projects and products with a desire to understand, and to increase the end users' experience with the product. I take the initiative to learn skills that will allow me to continue to grow in the field.  I took courses in C# so that I could debug and follow the process through source code in Visual Studio to a root cause.  I can maximize the validation and isolation of bugs and issues allowing a developer a quicker cycle for a coded fix. I learned Python to manage the build for Altiris/Symantec on my initiative. I have taken courses through Pluralsight on JavaScript and HTML/HTML5 so I can better understand Web Applications. I am unafraid to take on new projects and see them to a successful conclusion. I am eager to learn how to automate an entire test cycle.

Specialties: Python scripting, Sql (PostgreSQL) knowledge, VMWare, Linux Basics, Jenkins, Postman, Developer Tools (IE, Chrome, FireFox), JavaScript Basics, C# intermediate level, Visual Studio.

positions.title: Senior Software Developer in Test
positions.description: I am so excited to start my next chapter as a Senior SDET at CHG.  This company has been all I have hoped for since reaching out to them 3+ years ago.  They allowed me to learn and to grow and for that I am forever grateful.  Now I begin my roll as a team mentor and to continue the push for quality.

positions.title: Software Developer In Test II
positions.description: I am so pleased I got a promotion this week at CHG!  I have learned so much about my role as an SDET since being hired at CHG.  I Love my team, there are so many great developers who care about quality as much as I do.  The management at CHG is also supportive of quality releases.  I look forward to continued learning, working hard and keeping the code as good as I can.

positions.title: Software Development Engineer In Test
positions.description:
Working to make automated test efficient and quick.
Creating unique environments so tests can run independently of each other

positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description:
FINWISE BANK | 2018-NOW
QA ENGINEER/MANAGER – 2018
· Initiated Postman scripted testing for the existing API product with no front end, complete test series for available method calls both internal and external all done through postman interface and collections.
· Updated all documentation for the existing product based on Postman tests.
· Implemented a Confluence site to manage Federal GLBA requirements.
· Implemented a Jira project to manage GLBA Yearly evaluations.

positions.title: Software Developer In Test
positions.description:
·Took Plural Sight C# programming language so I could become a junior developer in test on the SaaS platform project
·C#/JavaScript development for the Central Logic SaaS Platform, fixing bugs, and managing user stories for each sprint
·Took over the C# HL7 Engine code updating as needed, and enhancing performance
·Completed HL7.Org HL7 Fundamentals Course and certification to become the HL7 expert for Central Logic
·Using C# or Developer Tools Debugged issues to the source of the error for faster resolution by developers

positions.title: Developer for Data Intelligence
positions.description:
·Reskinned the MicroStrategy web Interface, unifying the look to work with the existing branding for Central Logic and the Data Intelligence product.  Using CSS and Plugins a skin was developed for the Central Logic Data Intelligence release v.1
·Undertook the process of rebranding the MicroStrategy mobile iPad app for internal download.

positions.title: Workflow Developer
positions.description:
Worked exclusively with workflow testing and modification of workflows to debug critical issues.  Worked with the HL7 and IVR systems in understanding how the workflows drive the process.
Integrated the Core Application into Jenkins Build system integrated with VM as build servers, making the build a clean build with VM backups as Restoration points for archival points so a build can be recreated if needed.
Created Custom Implementation Flows to aid in getting customer sites implemented quickly.

positions.title: Senior CM Engineer
positions.description:
* I took the initiative to learn python so that I could take over the build process used by the development team when the developer responsible for it left the company. I was able to maintain the framework he devised as well as update and modify the build scripts to add functionality to gather binaries, sign binaries and .msi as well as automate other aspects of the build.
* I integrated over 25 builds in the Jenkins framework within a 6 month period bringing the project to a conclusion early, it was scheduled to be done and in use by 2011-2012 and it was up and running producing viable and consistent builds almost 6-8 months early.
* I created many of the necessary scripts (python) to automate pre-build and post-build steps as well as datastore clean up.  I also created scripts to be used by all teams for signing, renaming and publishing .msi to all test locations.
* Duties: setup Jenkins framework integrates all 30+ solutions into the framework, maintain the vm farm for builds, manage build scripts and update process for more efficiency. Integrate Coverity Static Analysis into build farm systems.

positions.title: Lead Test Engineer in Development
positions.description:
I was responsible for managing the release of builds to the test team based on smoke tests which were run against each build, including regression tests of bugs which were targeted as priority fixes.
	I automated my smoke tests using Auto-it and Altiris Deployment Solution so that the build would be installed and tested and then I would post the results in email to all testers with build status and known issues.
	I worked closely with test and support teams to identify core set of tests to be included in the smoke test process for each build.

Duties: Regression testing, smoke test nightly builds and publish good builds to all test teams for QA testing.

positions.title: Assigned Support Engineer
positions.description:
Contracted support to high profile customers with 24/7 support, worked closely with customers for implementation plans and execution of the implementation.  I worked with customers on site with fixes and any necessary work around.
	Initiated Tip of the Day email with known issues and possible work around for my assigned clients, internal support team, internal documentation teams and developers.
	Published over 1000 KB articles and forum postings to the support forums and knowledge base

Duties: manage 3 pay for support high profile customers issues, get resolutions or find a work around to support their needs. Help other support team members with TOI.
